  • Charge 1 of your installed cards. (Add 1 power counter to a card that already has one.)

printings.flavor: Waiting is useless. The crisis is here; pick a side.

We're all alike down here
Androids are friends we salute
Give us all a f***ing break
Ol' Jack is the s*** on my boot.
We can change the world, if we're willing to be changed in return.
Reactive implants reclaim the memories of our fallen comrades. Their sacrifice is our shield.
Arming the resistance with disarming charm.
He didn't speak, but I knew exactly what he wanted, and what I had to do.
"Sometimes being a union rep calls for action even more... direct."
A single spark is all that it takes to destroy billions of credits... or to burn away the rot that ravages our world.
All is folding back, ever back; together as one.
Flaws hold both beauty and opportunity.
The best moment to listen is when others are listening to you.
Neneciğim would be proud.
Skimming credits with the slightest touch.
I can show you a carpet, a fish, a magical tale...
The feel of flour-fine coffee, the scent of caramelizing sugar, the gentle heat of the flame. A ritual I never forget.

"Aim with your eye. Shoot with your mind. Break with your soul."
–Sundog
One step back. Take cover. Two steps forward. Repeat, then secure well.
If there's anything to be learned from our android cousins, it's that there's no shortcut to perfection. Consider all your options.
The sea is everything; its breath must remain pure and healthy.
Edie doesn't mind the noise. She's happy just being nearby.
Within netspace, tangible space can be manipulated as desired, and fluid dynamics rarely factors into ice development.
"That's him at the front, then there's Scout, Jonesy, Parker, Buča, Squee, Boots... you get the idea."

"Why are we here? No one else is going to do independent testing, that's why."
–Padma Isbister
Every ship is a home, and every home needs a heart.
Ancient paradoxes are children's stories to the greatest minds ever designed.

"The Midnight-3 glows with an inviting warmth that belies the broken promise within. All that awaits you there is a life of indentured servitude."
–Sundog

"The promise of a new home, safe work and friendly neighbors will draw in tens of thousands of eco-refugees, no matter which corner of the world they are from."
–Thule employee handbook
At depths no human tech can reach, a Trieste proxy can manipulate a mindscape with unparalleled precision. Designed by 2019 World Champion Oliver "Pinsel" Siccha
End the run. End the run. End the run. End the run.
With networks, growth is exponential.
Designed by 2018 North American Champion Sam Suied
Some tests require specific conditions.

"Esteemed guests, by the end of this demonstration you will see that extinction is now only a temporary state of affairs."
–Vientiane Keeling
Prey and seawater sucked in, all in the space of a millisecond.
Designed by the Borealis Playtesters
Ethereal beauty laced with the most elegant venom.
Digital refuse is their food, and you should never come between an animal and its food.
Keep off the grass.
One becomes many.
Viruses, runners; all are food to them.
Political news, fit for public consumption.
The line goes up... until we don't need it to anymore.
The only thing that changes is the uniform.
"Tell them Drago would like a word." Designed by 2019 European Champion Aaryn "Drago" Byrne
They say they'll only take a handful, but oh what big hands they have!
Names of old carry little weight today, their legacies broken and swept away. Now, we are the rulers of truth.
No task the witch set would ever be too great, for Vasilisa had her mother's blessing.
"Recording devices at the door, please!"
Straddling the banks of the Ob River, this metropolis contains hope for a better tomorrow.
Take all that is offered, and more.

"Don't worry, directors, security is always willing to send agents to assist with radical asset reassignment."
–Yakov Avdakov
It doesn't matter how long you've owned the land, you'd better hope there's nothing valuable beneath.
Confound the runner so that they cannot see our true intent.
Centuries of military tactics compressed into a single entity.
Leave nothing of value behind.
Designed by 2020 Asia-Pacific Champion Sam Keilback
Identify. Contact. Entrap. Counterintelligence never changes.
